assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Regular hexagon with vertices 0 to 5 and centre O, its three long diagonals in red and six short diagonals in blue, and the 13 interior intersection points marked: O, six points on a dotted circle of radius 1/2 and six on a dotted circle of radius 1/sqrt 3.

difficulty_rationale: Counting crossing pairs by sets of four vertices is a known idea, but the coincidences (the triple point at the centre) must be found and the remaining points shown distinct.
